plainTranslation: Warmth and need pulling in different directions. One wants closeness where the other offers a different flavor of care. Failure mode: mismatched bids for affection. Name what comforts you each; the difference can complement once it's spoken.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: What you need and what they value pull slightly apart. Affection and comfort are a little crossed. Ask for the specific comfort instead of the grand gesture.
tension: The challenge comes when expectations go unspoken. You may give what feels meaningful to you and feel disappointed when it is not fully appreciated. They may do the same. If you are not careful, you can start telling yourself stories about what the other person's response means, when in reality both of you may be making sincere efforts.
advice: The opportunity here is communication. Instead of assuming your partner should know what makes you feel loved, teach them. Be curious about what helps them feel cared for too. When both people are willing to learn each other's language, the connection becomes stronger, warmer, and much easier to trust.
summaryShort: What you need and what they value pull slightly apart.
